## Why visit

A small neighbourhood bar whose balanced cask approach is particularly relevant to experienced drinkers: the intention is to offer a pale, a bitter and a porter or stout rather than a row of near-identical beers. Flights and bottle shopping make it suitable for deliberate comparison. It is worth considering when exploring south Manchester, especially because the railway station is close. This is a beer-and-community destination rather than a heritage room, so prioritise it when the range and atmosphere appeal more than another ornate pub interior.

## Beer

CAMRA describes three handpulls intended to cover pale ale, bitter and porter/stout, with keg-conditioned options and bottles/cans.
